beats.text:

The top void words are predominantly related to conflict ("airstrikes", "air strike", "drone strike", "missiles", etc.) and geopolitical tensions ("trade war," "renminbi"). However, they did this in a way that preserved attribution, suggesting they were not avoiding the topic but rather managing how it was presented.

The states WEEKLY, CONSOLIDATION and CONTTESTED are dominant - suggesting a meta-level focus on summarizing, interpreting and resolving ambiguity.
